name: web-archiver
description: Save web pages you give it as offline copies: the article is extracted (Readability), images are saved locally, and each capture keeps the source URL and capture time as a single offline HTML file, Markdown, the original HTML and metadata. Capture the same page again later to see exactly which paragraphs changed. Optional full-page screenshots with your local Chrome or Edge. Only fetches the URLs you give and the images in them; no API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把你给的网页存成离线资料：提取正文（Readability），图片保存到本地，每次采集都记下来源网址和采集时间，生成单文件离线 HTML、Markdown、原始 HTML 和元数据。同一网页再次采集时，逐段标出正文改了什么。可选用本机 Chrome / Edge 截整页图。只访问你给的网址和其中的图片，无需 API 密钥。
